CheckTitle: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
Description: Active IAM access keys must be rotated at least every 90 days. Regular rotation limits the exposure window of a potentially compromised key and enforces a hygiene cadence for programmatic credential management.
Risk: Long-lived access keys that are never rotated remain valid indefinitely once compromised. A key exfiltrated months ago continues to provide access until rotation. Rotation limits the damage window of an undetected breach.
Remediation: Rotate access keys every 90 days or less. Create a new key, update all applications using the old key, then deactivate and delete the old key. Automate rotation tracking via AWS Config rule access-keys-rotated.
SeverityBasis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 Control 1.14 (Level 1); AWS Security Hub FSBP IAM.3 (ASFF score 64 / MEDIUM)
AuthoritativeSource: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0; AWS Security Hub FSBP
